items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Thad Jones got me to go back to the tenor trombone... I had been with Thad Jones, I played clinics.

ctx.x: Of course, the last time I talked to him he told me he was trying. And he tries to tell me about kids talking about me, that kids -- that I had been with Thad Jones, I played clinics.
Well, he was the one that would go around and tell them about you, --

items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Thad Jones is to me one of the greatest arrangers today.

ctx.x: Thad Jones is to me one of the greatest arrangers today. But Thad will -- he doesn't believe in being a politician, so that's --
